# Sub-Quadratic Audio Transformer Engine
> A Bare-Metal, Lock-Free O(N) Attention Engine for Infinite Continuous Audio Streaming.

## Core Files
- `include/attention.hpp` & `src/kernels/attention_forward.cpp`: C++ core engine logic for sub-quadratic associative scan algorithms.
- `include/arena.hpp` & `src/arena.cpp`: VRAM Memory Allocator managing O(1) buffer allocations.
- `python/bindings.cpp`: PyBind11 wrapper granting Frictionless Zero-Copy FFI access to Python.
- `tests/verify_stress.py`: Comprehensive test suite demonstrating Dead Air Underflow prevention, Concurrent Firehose Async GIL-locks, and Ghost Leak hunting.

## Key Concepts
- **O(1) VRAM Tracking**: Achieved through cyclic offset bounds checking inside `MemoryArena` instead of destructive reallocation.
- **Mathematical Decay ($\lambda$)**: Stable gradient bounding achieved via `decay_factor` (`0.99f`), maintaining bounded `S_t` states across millions of tokens.
- **FTZ Subnormal Stalls**: Engine features robust floating-point manipulation clamping software limits around 1e-15f to maintain TTFC during "Dead Air" streaming.
- **Zero-Copy Handoff**: Memory leaks and PyBind bounds violations resolved through standard `py::capsule` garbage-collected ownership wrappers.
